title: BC lightstation sea surface temperature with QARTOD-style quality flags (R workflow and data)
description: R workflow that retrieves daily BC lightstation sea surface temperature (BCSOP) from CIOOS Pacific ERDDAP, applies automated quality control tests adapted from IOOS QARTOD, and publishes CF-1.8/ACDD-1.3 NetCDF and CSV outputs with a data dictionary. Independent portfolio product, not an official DFO or CIOOS release. Source data: Institute of Ocean Sciences, Fisheries and Oceans Canada, Open Government Licence - Canada.
